label: def:threading-link
title: Threading link $T(2,N)$
html:
Definition. Threading link T(2,N)

Definition. Let \mathcal{A}_1, \ldots, \mathcal{A}_N be atoms arranged in a cycle. The threading link of the ring is the torus link

  \mathcal{T}_N =  T(2, N),

whose closure in the braid group B_N is

  \hat{\beta}_N
  = 
  (\sigma_1  \sigma_2  \cdots  \sigma_{N-1})^2.

The threading link winds twice around the torus defined by the N atoms, passing through every atom on each winding. It has 2(N-1) crossings.

Component structure. The number of components of T(2,N) is \gcd(2,N). For even N, the threading link is a 2-component link. These two components are the topological realisation of the two delocalised \pi electrons.
